title: Bounded build-warning assessment

method.note: Counts use execution diagnostics before Build succeeded. The final summary reproduces every diagnostic once. Identical advisory IDs across different projects remain separate project diagnostics; there are five unique advisory IDs.

advisories.impact_and_preconditions: Excessive allocation while parsing malformed ICC CLUT metadata. For ImageSharp v1-v3, the relevant public path accesses IccProfile.Entries after decode; automatic conversion applies to v4. The advisory demonstrates memory pressure, not unhandled process termination.

Unsafe histogram indexing can terminate a process when a crafted floating-point TIFF is decoded as HalfVector4 and HistogramEqualization is applied. This is operation-specific, not a claim about every image load.
TIFF CCITT Group 3 one-bit encoding can overrun its output buffer and terminate the process. Re-encoding TIFF with retained compression metadata can reach this path.

TIFF CCITT Group 4 one-bit encoding can write beyond its logical buffer. The advisory reproduces an unhandled exception during decode and re-encode; this assessment makes no remote-code-execution claim.
A malformed BigTIFF entry count can keep one decoder thread busy without consuming input. The advisory demonstrates prolonged execution of one invocation, not worker-pool exhaustion.

reachability.scope: Bounded static search of first-party src C# and Razor files, excluding obj and bin, followed by inspection of ImageSharp use sites. No exploit execution or full call-graph audit.

observations.finding: Creates a fixed 256 x 256 Image<Rgba32> from terrain flags.
Creates a fixed 256 x 256 Image<Rgba32> from terrain flags.
Writes the generated terrain bitmap with SaveAsPng.
Converts generated terrain image to PNG using PngFormat.Instance.
Converts generated terrain image to PNG using PngFormat.Instance.

reachability.conclusion: No direct route to these five vulnerable operations was established in the inspected first-party image uses. This is not proof of non-reachability or non-exploitability.
limits: No inspection of third-party package internals, dynamically loaded plugins, reflection paths, or deployment network controls.
No end-to-end trace from all input entry points; keyword search can miss aliases or indirect use.
The build log is a point-in-time warning list, not an exhaustive current vulnerability scan.
Existing successful builds and tests do not establish security of untested operations.

assessment.private_alpha: These warnings do not by themselves invalidate an isolated private-alpha checkpoint. Continuing such a checkpoint is conditional on verified restricted access, trusted inputs/operators, no untrusted image decode or TIFF processing, bounded resources, and owner acceptance of remaining risk. Those deployment controls were not verified in this assessment.
assessment.future_public: Do not treat successful build/tests as public-release security approval. Before public exposure, close the dependency-risk decision with a reviewed compatibility/remediation plan or defensible non-reachability evidence and compensating controls, and review the concrete runtime-oriented warnings. No public-readiness verdict is established here.
assessment.dependency_change: The advisory-listed patched version 4.1.2 is factual reference information, not a recommendation to upgrade automatically. The current ImageSharp.Drawing 1.0.0 pin and API/runtime/license compatibility require a separate, approved evaluation. No dependency was changed.
follow_up_priorities: Review the five ImageSharp advisories against the intended deployment and any image-processing plugins before public exposure.
Review VSTHRD101 at ServerController.cs:93 and the two VSTHRD003 diagnostics for exception/deadlock behavior.
Review CA2265 span/default comparisons and RZ10012 access-denied component rendering; the latter does not itself demonstrate an authorization bypass.
Address ASP0006 and BL0007 rendering/component diagnostics with focused tests if those UI surfaces are in scope.
Track style, generated-documentation, obsolete API, hiding, unused event, and optional-argument warnings separately from security advisories.
